resolution.title: Add a reviewed samplesheet adapter
resolution.detail: Somite can visualize this samplesheet step, but it does not yet have a reviewed transform that writes the exact nf-core RNA-seq schema from the connected reads.

recipes.title: Build a tested RNA-seq samplesheet transform
recipes.summary: Define the exact row schema, optional paired-read behavior, and emitted file before making this node executable.
steps: Pin the target nf-core/rnaseq samplesheet schema.
Map connected single-end or paired-end reads into one deterministic row.
Prove the emitted CSV with a representative fixture before accepting the adapter.
